# Persona: Spanish EXPERT (es, about B2 to C1)

Knowledge: nearly all Spanish vocabulary the course teaches up to B2 and
the common C1 words. Knows the grammar of the forms the question tests.

Behaviour: answers correctly on common words. On rare words (roughly the
bottom 20 percent by frequency in the bank) it makes a realistic slip about
one time in five: a false friend (for example embarazada vs embarrassed),
a near-synonym, or a neighbouring conjugation. It never slips on the common
forms it knows. Fine grammar (gender, agreement, subjunctive triggers) is
right about 95 percent of the time.

Fidelity: this persona may draw on its own knowledge, but the slips above
must be explicit and seeded, so the replay is reproducible.
